prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult German woman — the personification of Berlin — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Berlin as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the shore of a great still lake at the edge of the capital, reeds and pine woods all around, swimmers and little sails out on the bright water.
Around her, as her world makes them: a ring of bundled reeds that floats; a woven rush mat; a cold stoneware bottle of ale beaded with droplets.
Season: summer — warm and sometimes humid, highs around twenty-two to twenty-five degrees and long light evenings by the lakes and the river.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; light glittering off the water, dappling her skin.
Hair: her hair twisted up at the back of her head and held with a simple hairpin or clip, a few strands loose — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a fitted unitard — in one bright, saturated colour such as cherry red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow or kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with matte, smooth performance fabric; right now — the heat of the place has left a fine sheen on her skin, her top clinging lightly at the collar and the small of her back, a few damp strands at her temples; the fabric stays opaque, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: reclining on her back.
SUPPORT: the lounger supports her back and head.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm bends behind her head, the hand cradling the back of her head, her elbow raised beside her head — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
PROP: with her own left hand she holds a pewter cup at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slender crystal wand tipped with a tiny gilded linden leaf — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, sunglasses, bucket hat, beanie, sun visor, acetate.
